problems.title: Design Dual Circuit Breakers

source.preview_scope: group-level; not a complete variant specification

inference_basis_fields: contentPreview: a circuit breaker opens after several consecutive failures of a primary server, blocking or rerouting further requests, and after a cooldown tries to reset; the dual-breaker rules are cut off
the usual closed / open / half-open circuit-breaker pattern (general knowledge of the inferring model)
problems.inferred_spec: DualCircuitBreaker(failureThreshold, cooldown) guards a primary and a secondary server with one breaker each, both closed. A closed breaker allows attempts and counts consecutive failures; reaching failureThreshold opens it at that time and resets the count. An open breaker opened at time o allows an attempt at time t only when t - o >= cooldown; that attempt is a trial: success closes the breaker, failure reopens it at t. Any success of a closed breaker resets its count. request(timestamp, primaryOk, secondaryOk) gives the outcome each server would have: if the primary breaker allows, the primary is attempted and a success returns "PRIMARY"; otherwise (blocked or failed) the request is rerouted to the secondary if its breaker allows, returning "SECONDARY" on success and "FAILED" on failure; when the secondary is blocked it returns "FAILED" if the primary was attempted and "BLOCKED" if no server was attempted. Timestamps are non-decreasing. Every method call is answered in call order on one instance.
